instruction.text: Welche Stichwörter passen zu den Sehenswürdigkeiten oder Wohngegenden? Ordne sie zu.
instruction.sound: Welche Stichwörter passen zu den Sehenswürdigkeiten oder Wohn gegnden? Ordne sie zu.

instruction.text: Hör dir die Fragen der Personen an und hilf Ihnen mit deinem neu gewonnenen Wissen über New York.

atoms.a: Hi my name is Sarah, and I am a big fan of colourful areas. When I am in the big city, I want to eat tasty and cheap food. Also, I want to buy some souvenirs, a place where I can find some street sellers would be great!

Oh hello, good to see you. Since you know New York well, I have a question. Whenever I am visiting a city, I try to get a view from above. Do you have a recommendation, where I can go to be high above the city?
Oh hi, my friends are going to visit me this weekend. Do you have any idea where we could have a nice dinner? The weather should be sunny, so dinner outside would be great.
I am new to the city and haven't found out yet where I can listen to nice gospel music. I am living in Manhattan, do you know somewhere that is not too far away?

Thanks for your help to get an orientated in the city. I have enough of being in the crowds. Tomorrow I would like to do something relaxing and maybe see the city or the skyline from afar. I could also imagine taking a nice boat trip on the river. Do you have any recommendations where to go to combine those things?
Since it was freezing the last few weeks, I would love to go ice-skating. You said there is a lake known for ice-skating somewhere in Manhattan. Can you tell me where it is located exactly?

I saw many pictures on social media of a colourful place with bright lights and huge neon signs. In the caption it said that there are many restaurants and also famous theatres. I think it was called Times Square. Do you know what area it is located in?

Today I have done a free walking tour through Manhattan. We've walked along this famous shopping street, I think it was called Fifth Avenue. We came across a really thin building, but I completely forgot the name of it. Do you know the name?
